section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'When one of you prostrates, let him put his hands down before his knees, and not kneel like a camel
